stage = "development" runs only the development-set step (choosing the number of
STM topics); stage = "test" runs everything. In real mode, stage = "test" stops
unless Analysis/text_frozen/text_config.json is frozen (Section 7.1).

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
root <- normalizePath(file.path(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir") %||% getwd(), ".."))
if (!file.exists(file.path(root, "Analysis", "R", "config.R"))) root <- normalizePath(".")
for (f in c("config.R", "prepare.R", "models.R", "text_stats.R")) source(file.path(root, "Analysis", "R", f))
stopifnot(params$mode %in% c("simulated", "real"), params$stage %in% c("development", "test"))
cfg <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(root, "Analysis", "text_frozen", "text_config.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
if (params$mode == "real" && params$stage == "test") {
  if (!isTRUE(cfg$frozen)) stop("text_config.json is not frozen: the test set cannot be analyzed yet (plan, Section 7.1).")
  dirty <- system2("git", c("-C", shQuote(root), "status", "--porcelain", "--", "Analysis/text_frozen"), stdout = TRUE)
  if (length(dirty)) stop("Analysis/text_frozen has uncommitted changes; commit the frozen configuration first.")
}
REASON_CODES <- c("permission", "transformation", "nature_of_work", "amount_used", "market_effect", "profit",
                  "credit", "nonmonetary_harm", "fame_status_power", "fairness_moral", "law_rules", "remedy",
                  "reliance")
LEGAL_ITEMS <- c("AllowedReason", "Jury", "CostReason", "ReduceMarket")   # the four legal ratings (Section 3)
set.seed(SEED)
base <- file.path(root, "Analysis", "output", params$mode)
tdir <- file.path(base, "text")
out_dir <- file.path(tdir, "stats"); dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_tab <- function(x, name) { write.csv(x, file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE, na = ""); invisible(x) }
show <- function(x, digits = 3) knitr::kable(x, digits = digits, row.names = FALSE)
perms <- if (params$mode == "real") cfg$permanova_permutations else 999
ridge_perms <- if (params$mode == "real") cfg$ridge$permutations else 20
```

**Data mode: `r params$mode`; stage: `r params$stage`.** `r if (params$mode == "simulated") "SYNTHETIC data, hashing stand-in embeddings, and a keyword stand-in coder: these results test the code only." else ""`

```{r load}
ti <- read.csv(file.path(base, "text_input.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = c(pid = "character"))
ti <- ti[ti$text_ok, ]
mt <- read.csv(file.path(tdir, "masked_texts.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = c(pid = "character"))
ti$masked <- mt$masked[match(ti$pid, mt$pid)]
ti$t[ti$study == 1] <- NA
sets <- list(
  study2_test = ti$study == 2 & ti$text_set == "test" & ti$analyzed,
  study2_all  = ti$study == 2 & ti$analyzed,
  study1      = ti$study == 1
)
```

```{r development, eval = params$stage == "development"}
# Development stage: choose the number of STM topics on the development set (Section 7.6).
dev <- ti[ti$text_set == "dev", ]
dev$t0 <- ifelse(is.na(dev$t), 0, dev$t); meta <- data.frame(a = dev$a, v = dev$v, t = dev$t0, study = factor(dev$study))
sk <- stm_search_K(dev$masked, meta, unlist(cfg$stm$K_candidates), SEED)
save_tab(sk, "stm_searchK_development")
show(sk)
```

```{r stop_if_dev, eval = params$stage == "development"}
knitr::knit_exit()
```

# T1-T3: do explanations differ by condition? (planned tests, test set)

PERMANOVA on cosine distances between masked-text embeddings, main effects tested marginally (`r perms` permutations), with a dispersion test beside each. Holm across T1-T3 on the primary model. Supported if Holm-adjusted p < .05 with the primary model and p < .05 with at least two of the three check models.

```{r T}
test <- ti[sets$study2_test, ]
models <- c(cfg$embedding_models$primary$key, vapply(cfg$embedding_models$checks, function(m) m$key, ""))
TT <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(k) {
  X <- read_embeddings(file.path(tdir, "embeddings"), k, "masked", test$pid)
  cbind(model = k, permanova_T(X, test, perms, SEED))
}))
prim <- TT$model == models[1]
TT$p_holm <- NA; TT$p_holm[prim] <- p.adjust(TT$p[prim], "holm")
checks_sig <- sapply(c("T1", "T2", "T3"), function(T) sum(TT$p[!prim & TT$test == T] < ALPHA))
TT$supported <- NA
TT$supported[prim] <- TT$p_holm[prim] < ALPHA & checks_sig[TT$test[prim]] >= 2
dec <- file.path(tdir, "decoding_T1_T3.csv")
if (file.exists(dec) && file.info(dec)$size > 5) {
  d <- read.csv(dec, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  TT <- merge(TT, d[, c("model", "factor", "accuracy", "chance", "permutation_p")], by = c("model", "factor"), all.x = TRUE)
}
TT <- TT[order(TT$test, match(TT$model, models)), ]
show(save_tab(TT, "T1_T3_permanova"))
```

Exploratory: interactions, and the same tests on the raw (unmasked) text.

```{r T_explore}
inter <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(k) cbind(model = k,
  permanova_interactions(read_embeddings(file.path(tdir, "embeddings"), k, "masked", test$pid), test, perms, SEED))))
save_tab(inter, "T_interactions_exploratory")
raw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(k) cbind(model = k, version = "raw",
  permanova_T(read_embeddings(file.path(tdir, "embeddings"), k, "raw", test$pid), test, perms, SEED))))
show(save_tab(raw, "T1_T3_raw_text_exploratory"))
```

# Reason codes (exploratory)

Categories retained by the reliability gate (Section 7.5). Firth logistic regression with the study's factors; BH across categories and terms within each sample. Primary coder, then each check coder.

```{r codes}
gate <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(tdir, "coding", "retained_categories.json"))
if (params$mode == "real" && !(isTRUE(gate$dev_gate_applied) && isTRUE(gate$test_gate_applied)))
  stop("The reliability gate (development and test-set checks, Section 7.5) has not been applied.")
ret <- intersect(unlist(gate$retained), REASON_CODES)      # stance is never a reason code
coders <- c("gptoss", "claude", "gemini")
code_tabs <- list()
for (cd in coders) {
  codes <- read.csv(file.path(tdir, "coding", sprintf("codes_%s.csv", cd)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = c(pid = "character"))
  for (sn in names(sets)) {
    s <- ti[sets[[sn]], ]; st <- if (sn == "study1") 1 else 2
    cc <- codes[match(s$pid, codes$pid), ]
    tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ret, function(k) firth_terms(as.logical(cc[[k]]), s, st, label = k)))
    tab$coder <- cd; tab$sample <- sn
    tab$q_bh <- p.adjust(tab$p, "BH")
    code_tabs[[paste(cd, sn)]] <- tab
  }
}
codes_all <- do.call(rbind, code_tabs)
save_tab(codes_all, "reason_codes_firth")
show(codes_all[codes_all$coder == "gptoss" & codes_all$sample == "study2_test",
               c("code", "term", "prevalence", "estimate", "ci_low", "ci_high", "p", "q_bh")])
```

# Uptake (exploratory)

```{r uptake}
feat <- read.csv(file.path(tdir, "features.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = c(pid = "character"))
f2 <- function(s) feat[match(s$pid, feat$pid), ]
up <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(sets), function(sn) {
  s <- ti[sets[[sn]], ]; ff <- f2(s); st <- if (sn == "study1") 1 else 2
  rbind(cbind(sample = sn, firth_terms(as.logical(ff$uptake_fame), s, st, label = "mentions fame/status")),
        if (st == 2) cbind(sample = sn, firth_terms(as.logical(ff$uptake_change), s, st, label = "mentions change")))
}))
up$q_bh <- p.adjust(up$p, "BH")
show(save_tab(up, "uptake_firth"))
share <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("artist", "victim", "transform"), function(f) {
  s <- ti[sets$study2_all, ]; ff <- f2(s)
  x <- data.frame(level = s[[f]], fame = as.numeric(as.logical(ff$uptake_fame)), change = as.numeric(as.logical(ff$uptake_change)))
  cbind(factor = f, aggregate(cbind(fame, change) ~ level, data = x, FUN = mean))
}))
save_tab(share, "uptake_shares_study2")
```

# Word measures, passive voice, dictionaries, semantic axes (exploratory)

```{r words}
wl <- grep("^count_", names(feat), value = TRUE)
wm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(sets), function(sn) {
  s <- ti[sets[[sn]], ]; ff <- f2(s); st <- if (sn == "study1") 1 else 2
  r <- rbind(do.call(rbind, lapply(wl, function(w) count_model(ff[[w]], ff$n_tokens, s, st, sub("^count_", "", w)))),
             passive_model(ff$passive_clauses, ff$clauses, s, st))
  cbind(sample = sn, r)
}))
wm$q_bh <- ave(wm$p, wm$sample, FUN = function(p) p.adjust(p, "BH"))
show(save_tab(wm[wm$sample == "study2_test", ], "word_measures"))
save_tab(wm, "word_measures_all_samples")
dict_cols <- grep("^(mfd2_|emfd_)", names(feat), value = TRUE)
if (length(dict_cols)) {
  dm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(sets), function(sn) {
    s <- ti[sets[[sn]], ]; ff <- f2(s); st <- if (sn == "study1") 1 else 2
    do.call(rbind, lapply(dict_cols, function(dc) { s$y_ <- ff[[dc]]; cbind(sample = sn, coef_table(fit_lm(s, "y_", st), st, dc)) }))
  }))
  save_tab(dm, "moral_dictionaries")
}
ddr <- read.csv(file.path(tdir, "ddr_scores.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = c(pid = "character"))
dd <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(sets), function(sn) {
  s <- ti[sets[[sn]], ]; st <- if (sn == "study1") 1 else 2; dr <- ddr[match(s$pid, ddr$pid), ]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(setdiff(names(ddr), "pid"), function(ax) { s$y_ <- dr[[ax]]; cbind(sample = sn, coef_table(fit_lm(s, "y_", st), st, ax)) }))
}))
save_tab(dd, "semantic_axes")
```

# Party focus (exploratory)

How often each party is named (negative binomial with a log(words) offset), and whether the primary coder judged the explanation negative toward each party, among explanations that mention that party (Firth logistic).

```{r party}
codes_p <- read.csv(file.path(tdir, "coding", "codes_gptoss.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = c(pid = "character"))
pf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(sets), function(sn) {
  s <- ti[sets[[sn]], ]; ff <- f2(s); st <- if (sn == "study1") 1 else 2; cp <- codes_p[match(s$pid, codes_p$pid), ]
  rbind(cbind(sample = sn, count_model(ff$mentions_martinez, ff$n_tokens, s, st, "mentions of Martinez"))[, c("sample", "feature", "term", "n", "estimate", "p")],
        cbind(sample = sn, count_model(ff$mentions_rivera, ff$n_tokens, s, st, "mentions of Rivera"))[, c("sample", "feature", "term", "n", "estimate", "p")],
        do.call(rbind, lapply(c("martinez", "rivera"), function(pty) {
          sent <- cp[[paste0("sentiment_", pty)]]; k <- !is.na(sent) & sent != "not_mentioned"
          r <- firth_terms(sent[k] == "negative", s[k, ], st, label = paste("negative toward", pty))
          data.frame(sample = sn, feature = r$code, term = r$term, n = r$n, estimate = r$estimate, p = r$p)
        })))
}))
pf$q_bh <- ave(pf$p, pf$sample, FUN = function(p) p.adjust(p, "BH"))
show(save_tab(pf, "party_focus"))
```

# Linking explanations to ratings (exploratory)

```{r ridge}
rr <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("study2_all", "study1"), function(sn) do.call(rbind, lapply(c("raw", "masked"), function(ver) {
  s <- ti[sets[[sn]], ]
  X <- read_embeddings(file.path(tdir, "embeddings"), models[1], ver, s$pid)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(PRIMARY, function(o) cbind(sample = sn, text = ver, outcome = o,
    ridge_table(X, s[[o]], cfg$ridge$folds, if (params$mode == "real") cfg$ridge$bootstrap else 200, ridge_perms, SEED, models[1]))))
}))))
show(save_tab(rr, "ridge_verdict"))
```

```{r stance}
codes <- read.csv(file.path(tdir, "coding", "codes_gptoss.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = c(pid = "character"))
s <- ti[sets$study2_all, ]; cc <- codes[match(s$pid, codes$pid), ]
verdict <- ifelse(s$Jury >= 4, "favors_rivera", ifelse(s$Jury <= 2, "favors_martinez", "mixed_or_unclear"))
s$stance_agrees <- cc$stance == verdict
show(save_tab(aggregate(stance_agrees ~ cell, data = s, FUN = mean), "stance_verdict_agreement_by_cell"))
save_tab(cbind(sample = "study2_all", firth_terms(s$stance_agrees, s, 2, label = "stance agrees with Jury")), "stance_verdict_firth")
rbv <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ret, function(k) {
  x <- data.frame(verdict = verdict, has = as.numeric(as.logical(cc[[k]])))
  cbind(code = k, aggregate(has ~ verdict, data = x, FUN = mean))
}))
save_tab(rbv, "reasons_by_verdict")
beyond <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ret, function(k) firth_terms(as.logical(cc[[k]]), s, 2, covars = c("AllowedReason", "Jury"), label = k)))
beyond$q_bh <- p.adjust(beyond$p, "BH")
save_tab(beyond, "reasons_beyond_verdict")
# Reasons built only from codes that passed the gate (Section 7.5).
reason_sets <- list(reason_harm = intersect(c("nonmonetary_harm", "market_effect"), ret),
                    reason_fair = intersect("fairness_moral", ret), reason_perm = intersect("permission", ret))
reason_sets <- reason_sets[lengths(reason_sets) > 0]
for (nm in names(reason_sets))
  s[[nm]] <- as.integer(Reduce(`|`, lapply(reason_sets[[nm]], function(k) as.logical(cc[[k]]))))
later <- if (!length(reason_sets)) NULL else do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Harm", "Moral", "Payment"), function(o) {
  k <- names(reason_sets)
  f <- lm(stats::as.formula(paste(o, "~ a * v * t +", paste(LEGAL_ITEMS, collapse = " + "), "+", paste(k, collapse = " + "))), data = s)
  V <- sandwich::vcovHC(f, type = "HC3")
  data.frame(outcome = o, reason = k, estimate = coef(f)[k], se_hc3 = sqrt(diag(V))[k],
             p = 2 * pt(-abs(coef(f)[k] / sqrt(diag(V))[k]), f$df.residual), n = nobs(f))
}))
if (!is.null(later)) show(save_tab(later, "reasons_predict_later_ratings")) else cat("No harm, fairness, or permission code passed the gate.\n")
```

```{r matching}
rt <- file.path(base, "ratings", "study2_all_terms.csv")
if (file.exists(rt)) {
  r2 <- read.csv(rt, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  pairs <- data.frame(outcome = c("Harm", "Harm", "Payment", "Moral", "AllowedReason", "AllowedReason"),
                      code = c("nonmonetary_harm", "market_effect", "remedy", "fairness_moral", "permission", "transformation"))
  pairs <- pairs[pairs$code %in% ret, ]
  ct <- codes_all[codes_all$coder == "gptoss" & codes_all$sample == "study2_all", ]
  m <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) do.call(rbind, lapply(c("a", "v", "t"), function(tm) {
    rr_ <- r2[r2$outcome == pairs$outcome[i] & r2$term == tm, ]; cr <- ct[ct$code == pairs$code[i] & ct$term == tm, ]
    data.frame(term = tm, rating = pairs$outcome[i], rating_estimate = rr_$estimate, rating_p = rr_$p,
               text_code = pairs$code[i], text_log_odds = cr$estimate, text_p = cr$p)
  }))))
  show(save_tab(m, "matching_effects"))
}
```
